description: Catalog pointer for PLX company skills. Skill ids are authoritative in the skills repo manifest.json (packages[].skillIds).
notes: petralabx/skills is the canonical company skill content repo. The pin is a release tag rather than a sha: petralabx/skills tags each merge to main with v<manifest.version>, so v1.6.1 is readable, immutable, and resolves to exactly one commit. v1.6.1 carries the 71-skill plx-engineering-core bundle and corrects guided-project-discovery's documented validator paths for installed .cursor/skills consumers; v1.6.0 added the narration-first plx-knowledge-video pipeline. The pin is what colleagues resolve against, so a skill published to the catalog is not installable until this field moves. manifest.gitRef no longer exists: a manifest cannot name the commit that contains it, so the stamp was stale by construction, and PLX_MC preferring it over the pin nearly served the 39-skill v1.3.1 tree under a v1.4.0 pin. Provenance now comes from the ref actually fetched. legacySourceRepo documents the pre-migration source.
